title: Crystal Waterfall Citadel
description: A majestic glowing blue crystal formation stands atop a rocky outcrop, cascading multiple streams of bright turquoise water into a misty pool below. In the background, a massive dark mountain with a tall waterfall rises under a dramatic, stormy sky filled with heavy clouds.
prompt: A glowing translucent blue crystal citadel perched on a rocky ledge, pouring multiple bright turquoise waterfalls into a misty pool with floating ice chunks in the foreground. Behind it rises a towering dark mountain with another large waterfall, surrounded by pine trees and green hills under a dramatic stormy sky with heavy clouds and god rays.
